Treatment summary
Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with acute pain and restricted range of motion in the right
shoulder. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the kind and force of the crash, and the presenting complaints fit
that mechanism well. Imaging and clinical examination findings clearly confirm the shoulder injury. No prior injury to the same
body region is known from the history obtained. Care was delivered across 25 visits, consisting of physical therapy, graded
range-of-motion exercises, and pain management. Treatment ran somewhat longer than is typical for this injury, and progress was
gradual but steady. Billing records show two similar charges on the same day, which are currently being reviewed for accuracy.
Patient has been advised on a home exercise program and will be reassessed at discharge to determine residual limitation and
need for further care.

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
